title: Embodied Science Agents: Making Embodied Experimental Design Learnable
abstract: arXiv:2611.12958v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advances in large models have accelerated AI for Science toward agentic science, where AI agents autonomously conduct scientific discovery. Realising this vision requires closing the loop between computational reasoning and physical experimentation, positioning self-driving laboratories (SDLs) as critical enablers. However, existing SDLs exhibit a fundamental paradox: foundation model integration has increased linguistic sophistication while severing physical grounding. By treating models as disembodied planners that output symbolic workflows for separate robotic systems, current architectures inherently block the development of embodied experimental intuition. We argue that overcoming this paradox requires embedding \emph{learnability} along three interdependent axes: cognitive learnability (learning what to investigate), experimental learnability (learning where to search), and embodied learnability (learning how to act). translated_title: 具身科学智能体：让具身实验设计变得可学习
translated_abstract: 近期大型模型的进展推动了“AI for Science”向智能体科学方向发展，即AI智能体能够自主开展科学发现。实现这一愿景需要将计算推理与物理实验之间的闭环打通，因此自动驾驶实验室（SDLs）成为关键的使能因素。然而，现有SDL存在一个根本性悖论：基础模型的集成虽然提升了语言层面的精巧程度，却切断了物理层面的具身根基。当前架构将模型视为脱离身体的规划器，仅输出符号化的工作流程交由独立的机器人系统执行，这在本质上阻碍了具身实验直觉的发展。我们认为，克服这一悖论需要在三个相互依存的维度上嵌入“可学习性”：认知可学习性（学习研究什么）、实验可学习性（学习在哪里搜索）以及具身可学习性（学习如何行动）。（注：原始摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文指出当前自动驾驶实验室存在“语言能力增强但物理具身根基被切断”的根本悖论，并提出应沿认知、实验、具身三个相互依存的可学习性维度构建具身科学智能体，使实验设计本身成为可学习的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies a fundamental paradox in existing self-driving laboratories—growing linguistic sophistication paired with severed physical grounding—and proposes building embodied science agents by embedding learnability along three interdependent axes: cognitive, experimental, and embodied learnability, making experimental design itself learnable.
